main.description: How the account holder appears in one context. The record key names the context: an app, by the NSID authority its lexicons live under (e.g. `social.taproom`). Sparse by design: a field left out falls back to the account's base profile (`app.bsky.actor.profile`), so only what differs is written here. These records are public, like the rest of the repository: they separate presentations, they do not make them unlinkable.

description.description: Free-form profile text for this context.

avatar.description: Animated formats (GIF, WebP, AVIF) are allowed; whether to animate them is each app's choice.

hide.description: Base-profile fields not to show in this context, even though the base has them. A field set on this record is shown regardless: hiding only ever removes what would have been inherited.
